we conduct a human evaluation to evaluate the quality of golden plans generated in deliberate thinking process. Specifically, we randomly select 50 golden plan samples and employ three annotators in our lab to rate them from 1 (worst) to 5 (best) based on 4 metrics: (1) Relevance (Rel.): measures whether the golden plans capture all the key requirements in user instruction; (2) Coherence (Coh.): measures whether the orders of golden plans are aligned with human web browsing habit; (3) Match (Mat.): measures whether the operations in golden plans match the corresponding element in screenshot; (4) Overall: measures whether the plan is effective enough to guide decision-making.
